help.goal: Win all the chips. Make the best five card hand at showdown, or bet until everyone else folds.
steps: Blinds are posted for you and two hole cards arrive.
On your turn tap Fold, or tap Check or Call 20.
Tap − and + to size a raise, then tap Raise to 120.
Push everything with the same button when it reads All-in.
Cards run out to the river, the pot is paid, the next hand starts.
notes: Everyone starts on 1000 chips, blinds are 10 and 20, and busting out is permanent.
An all-in raise smaller than a full raise does not reopen the betting: players behind it may only call or fold.
Chips only. No money, no rebuys, no side games.
